title: Backlog Document v1
description: The single-source specs/backlog/BACKLOG.json document: 'active' holds every live backlog item; a closed item's terminal record lives in specs/backlog/_archive/backlog_histo.jsonl, never here. backlog.py is its one writer and validator.

schema.description: Document schema id — always the literal string 'backlog-v1'.

active.description: One entry per live backlog item, in document order; 'id' is unique within this array (backlog.py check).

id.description: Backlog slug — the retired '### <slug>' heading text. Stable identity; never renumbered or reused.

title.description: Short human-readable name — the retired '**Title:**' bullet.

opened.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the entry was opened — the retired '**Opened:**' bullet.

status.description: Live-stage token, lowercase; 'idea' is exempt from intents. A terminal word belongs to a backlog_histo.jsonl record, never to a live entry (backlog.py check).

description.description: One-paragraph description of the need — the retired '**Description:**' bullet.

provenance.description: Where this entry came from (operator request, or an intake-report item id + approval date) — the retired '**Provenance:**' bullet.

intents.description: Optional typed intents[]: each binds one change to one canonical subject anchor. Required once 'status' is past 'idea' (backlog.py check, LEDGER-BACKLOG-SCHEMA); absent or empty is valid at 'idea'.

kind.description: The registry source class this subject ref resolves against (dadaia_workspace.core.models.backlog.SubjectKind).

ref.description: The typed reference itself — 'path/to/module.py#Symbol' for kind=code (module-relative only; an absolute/operator-local path is refused at construction), a 'dadaia <command>' id for kind=cli, a catalog.json feature slug for kind=catalog, a SPEC-DOC id or memory heading anchor for kind=doc, an INV-* id for kind=invariant.

surface.description: 'existing' (default) — ref must resolve to a live registry anchor. 'new' — this item INTRODUCES the surface; bound by declared identity, never forced onto an unrelated existing anchor.

change.description: Human-readable delta this item proposes for the bound subject.
